title: Mixed Event — Secret Operation Valentine's Day — Episode3 Preparing to Bake Sweets!

meta.Event Outline: With Valentine's Day just on the horizon, Airi is planning a surprise for everyone to show them her gratitude. She happens to meet Saki and Emu, who both had similar ideas, and they form a Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you two already know what you're gonna make?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
I came up with a wonderhoy idea!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great!
Let's start finding what we'll need!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be making everything tomorrow, so make sure not to forget anything, alright?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Okay!
Confectionary Corner

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Everything's so sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This looks like the section for sugary toppings. Hey, they have ones that look like hearts and gems!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there's lots and lots of chocolate over here! They even have a chocolate spray!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're like kids in a toy store.
FYI, as colorful as everything here is, it's all edible!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's sooo cool!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, if we put all these on top of our chocolates, we could make them look like little toy boxes! Wouldn't that be super cute?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I like your idea, but that might be going a bit overboard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Look, they even have a chocolate pen!
You can draw whatever you want with it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!
I wanna try drawing Phenny with it☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They have them in all sorts of colors too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But these are a lot harder to use than you might imagine, so just keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that does seem really hard.
It's probably nothing like writing or drawing with a real pen...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But drawing on hard surfaces, like cookies, macarons or mini chocolate bars, isn't as challenging, so you could do some illustrations for those.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. All you have to do is take whatever picture you want to draw, sandwich it between some parchment paper, and trace and color on top of it using these chocolate pens.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll get the hang of it with a little practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I can do that!
Let's get all of these!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, these silvery gem things look really nice too. They're so pretty and sparkly...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whatever we make, these will make them even shinier, so let's get a bunch of these too...!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, hold on... All of these...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, hold your horses...
All this stuff's gonna make your sweets rock hard!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rock hard?!
Not fluffy, sweet and shiny...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They'll be shiny but... Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Listen, Emu...
This stuff's all nice and sparkly, but also hard and crunchy...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A little bit on a cake is sort of nice, but imagine every mouthful being filled with this stuff. What do you think will happen to everyone's teeth...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I-It'll make their teeth crumble to bits...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's going a bit too far...
But my point is that less is more!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I understand!
I promise to not put everyone's teeth in harm's way!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I might avoid getting too many of these.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, why don't we see what's over in that corner next?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that looks like everything we'll need for making chocolates!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was so much fun! We even got some adorable toppings and tracing paper!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to start☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that smells nice♪
I think it's coming from the Japanese confectionary shop next door!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right! It's like it's calling out to us♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The Japanese confectionary shop?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku mentioned something about going there with the others today...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I just got an amazing idea!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How wonderhoy would it be to find manju hiding inside a cake☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: M-Manju?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that would be a pretty big surprise...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
See what I mean☆
I'm gonna go buy some right now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
W-Wait, no...
Geez, she's quick!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm going after her.
Mind watching our baskets while I do, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your dessert recommendation was so yummy, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you really can't find anything like this on any shelf. I'll have to come back for that special manju and green tea set again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you both liked it so much♪ We'll have to bring Airi along next time as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, there's a ton of people over in the confectionary corner. Is there something going on today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-They're having a Valentine's Day event?! Oh no! I need to get started on that...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! N-No, Haruka, everything's just fine!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If you say so. Anyway, we should get going.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
I'd actually like to look at some crafts and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds nice. Why don't we go together?
Wait, manjus are a bad idea?
Because we're trying to make everything from scratch, remember? Anything you put into it would have to be homemade as well!
Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Voice
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: C'mon, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Be right there!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(That sure sounded like Airi...
But there's no way she'd be here right now...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Finally, we managed to get everything we need...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Airi.
I think we really are all set now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh♪
Our surprise is bound to be a huge success now☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to get baking!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, Emu, you seem super excited!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
All in good fun I suppose.
But this was the easy part!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! I'm really looking forward to baking at my house with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I'll have to clean up before then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't mind us.
You've been generous enough already by lending us your kitchen.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
She's right, Saki!
I get to actually bake gifts for my big brothers now because of that! You're a total lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially since our families would find out if we decided to bake at home...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're giving something to your big brother, right, Saki? Won't your family find out?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, we'll be fine.
Everyone's gonna be gone all day just as planned!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Then, let's all get ready for a day of baking tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!
